text: You can track your order from My Orders in your account, or with the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email. Tracking updates within 24 hours of dispatch.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 9.99. Orders placed after 6 PM ship the next business day.
If your order has not arrived within 7 business days, contact us with your order ID. We will trace the parcel with the courier and send a replacement or refund if it is lost.
You can return most items within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging. Start a return from My Orders, then print the prepaid label.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned item. You will get an email when the refund is processed.
Orders can be cancelled free of charge before they are shipped. Go to My Orders and choose Cancel. Once shipped, you must use the return process.
We accept credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and cash on delivery for orders under 5000. Wallet payments are not supported.
If a payment failed but money was debited, the amount is automatically reversed by your bank within 3 to 5 business days. If it is not, share the transaction ID with us.
You can change the delivery address before the order is shipped from My Orders. After shipping, contact support and we will try to redirect the parcel with the courier.
If you received a damaged, defective, or wrong item, send a photo and your order ID within 7 days. We will arrange a free pickup and send a replacement or full refund.
Electronics carry a 12 month manufacturer warranty from the delivery date. Warranty covers manufacturing defects but not accidental damage. Keep your invoice for claims.
On the login page choose Forgot password, enter your registered email, and follow the link we send. The link expires after 30 minutes.
Enter a discount code at checkout in the Promo field. Only one code can be used per order, and codes cannot be applied to items already on sale.
Our human support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM IST, by phone at 1800-000-1234 or email support@example.com. This chatbot is available 24/7.
If an item shows Out of Stock, use Notify Me on the product page and we will email you when it is back. Restocks usually take 2 to 3 weeks.
